text: Program Description Teaching Objective The colleague is aimed to train to adapt to the development of computer science, obsess scientific literacy and cultural accomplishment, the basic theoretical knowledge of computer science and practical theory. Course Structure We can see core courses of Computer Science and Technology among the four years: Course Name Credits Advanced Mathematics I 5.0 Programming Language C 4.5 Advanced Mathematics II 5.0 Discrete Mathematics 4.5 Algorithm and Data Structure 4.5 Comprehensive Chinese IV 4.5 Computer Organization 4.5 Computer Networks 4.0 Operating System 4.0 Microcontroller’s Principle and Applications 4.0 Career and Internship Graduates can be the senior computer technical engineers engage in the development, maintenance, technical service and technical management in the field of computer.
